license_required.quote: requiring each person who is practicing or is offering to practice nursing to submit evidence that the person is qualified to practice and to be licensed as provided in this chapter

issuing_authority.quote: Such evidence of qualifications shall be submitted to the state board of nursing, which is the regulatory body authorized to enforce this chapter.

name.quote: Adopt a seal that shall bear the words "Tennessee Board of Nursing" and the imprint thereof shall be placed upon all official papers of the board

type.quote: state board of nursing, which is the regulatory body authorized to enforce this chapter

umbrella_agency.value: Division of Health Related Boards, Department of Health
umbrella_agency.quote: the executive director shall operate under the supervision and control of the division of health related boards

moral_character_required.quote: Is in good physical and mental health

degree_required.value: Diploma or degree from an approved school of nursing
degree_required.quote: Has successfully completed a course of study in an approved school of nursing, as defined by the board, and the applicant holds a diploma or degree from an approved school of nursing

accrediting_body.quote: Approve such schools and courses as meet the requirements of this chapter and the rules and regulations of the board

exams.name: NCLEX-RN
exams.notes: Required for registered nurse licensure by examination
exams.quote: An applicant for a license to practice professional nursing shall be required to pass an examination in such subjects as the board may determine.

exams.name: NCLEX-PN
exams.notes: Required for licensed practical nurse licensure by examination
exams.quote: An applicant for a license to practice practical nursing shall be required to pass a written examination as prescribed by the board.

interval_years.quote: All licensed professional or registered nurses shall submit an application for renewal of licensure registration to the board of nursing with a biennial renewal fee as set by the board.

required.quote: the board of nursing shall implement a plan to assure continuing competence of licensees, using educationally sound methods to promote learning and assess outcomes pertinent to contemporary standards of nursing practice

available.quote: The board may issue a license to practice professional nursing to a professional or registered nurse who has been duly licensed in another state or territory if, in the opinion of the board, the individual meets the professional nurse qualifications that, at the time of the applicant's graduation, were in effect in this state.

requirements.value: Applicant must meet TN professional nurse qualifications in effect at time of graduation; board must render decision within 45 days of completed application; temporary permit available for 6 months pending permanent licensure.
requirements.quote: the board shall, within forty-five (45) days from the date the board receives the completed application: (i) Render a decision on the application; or (ii) Inform the applicant of the need to appear before the board.

regulatory_model.quote: Practice nursing as defined by this chapter unless duly licensed to do so under this chapter

credential_type.quote: The board shall issue a license to practice professional nursing to an applicant who successfully completes the examination.

is_mandatory.quote: It is a Class B misdemeanor for any person, corporation or association to: ... Practice nursing as defined by this chapter unless duly licensed to do so under this chapter

title_protection.quote: a person shall not use the title "nurse" or any other title, abbreviation, or designation in connection with the person's name, occupation, or profession to indicate or imply that the person is a practicing nurse unless the person is actively licensed or certified by the board of nursing.

scope_protection.quote: Practice nursing as defined by this chapter unless duly licensed to do so under this chapter

disciplinary_grounds.description: Fraud or deceit in procuring or attempting to procure a license to practice nursing
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Is guilty of fraud or deceit in procuring or attempting to procure a license to practice nursing

disciplinary_grounds.description: Unfit or incompetent by reason of negligence, habits or other cause
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Is unfit or incompetent by reason of negligence, habits or other cause

disciplinary_grounds.description: Addicted to alcohol or drugs to the degree of interfering with nursing duties
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Is addicted to alcohol or drugs to the degree of interfering with nursing duties

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violated or attempted to violate, directly or indirectly, or assisted in or abetted the violation of or conspired to violate any provision of this chapter or any lawful order of the board
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has violated or attempted to violate, directly or indirectly, or assisted in or abetted the violation of or conspired to violate any provision of this chapter or any lawful order of the board issued pursuant thereto.

definition_quote.value: "Practice of professional nursing" means the performance for compensation of any act requiring substantial specialized judgment and skill based on knowledge of the natural, behavioral and nursing sciences and the humanities as the basis for application of the nursing process in wellness and illness care.
definition_quote.quote: "Practice of professional nursing" means the performance for compensation of any act requiring substantial specialized judgment and skill based on knowledge of the natural, behavioral and nursing sciences and the humanities as the basis for application of the nursing process in wellness and illness care.

value: Responsible supervision of a patient requiring skill and observation of symptoms and reactions and accurate recording of the facts
Promotion, restoration and maintenance of health or prevention of illness of others
Counseling, managing, supervising and teaching of others
Administration of medications and treatments as prescribed by a licensed physician, dentist, podiatrist, or nurse authorized to prescribe
Application of such nursing procedures as involve understanding of cause and effect
Nursing management of illness, injury or infirmity including identification of patient problems
methods_authorized.quote: "Professional nursing" includes: (A) Responsible supervision of a patient requiring skill and observation of symptoms and reactions and accurate recording of the facts; (B) Promotion, restoration and maintenance of health or prevention of illness of others; (C) Counseling, managing, supervising and teaching of others; (D) Administration of medications and treatments as prescribed by a licensed physician, dentist, podiatrist, or nurse authorized to prescribe

drug_authority.value: Nurses authorized to prescribe pursuant to § 63-7-123 may write and sign prescriptions and/or issue drugs; nurse practitioners may prescribe controlled substances in Schedules II-V subject to formulary and physician collaboration requirements.
drug_authority.quote: The board shall issue a certificate of fitness to nurse practitioners who meet the qualifications, competencies, training, education and experience, pursuant to § 63-7-207(14), sufficient to prepare such persons to write and sign prescriptions and/or issue drugs within the limitations and provisions of § 63-1-132.

license_tiers.quote: Nurse practitioners, nurse anesthetists, nurse midwives and clinical nurse specialists holding such education and practice credentials shall apply to the board for a certificate to practice as an advanced practice registered nurse

aprn_role_categories.quote: "Advanced practice registered nurse" means a registered nurse with a master's degree or higher in a nursing specialty and national specialty certification as a nurse practitioner, nurse anesthetist, nurse midwife or clinical nurse specialist.

lpn_supervision_requirements.quote: carrying out medical orders prescribed by a licensed physician or dentist under the direction of a licensed physician, dentist or professional registered nurse

collaborative_practice_agreement_require.quote: A nurse who has been issued a certificate of fitness as a nurse practitioner pursuant to § 63-7-207 and this section shall file a notice with the board, containing the name of the nurse practitioner, the name of the licensed physician collaborating with the nurse practitioner who has control and responsibility for prescriptive services rendered by the nurse practitioner, and a copy of the formulary

full_independent_practice_available.quote: Failure by a person licensed under and required by this chapter to collaborate with a physician for any act within the person's licensed scope of practice constitutes a threat to the public health, safety, and welfare and imperatively requires emergency action by the board.

prescriptive_authority_certificate_requi.quote: The board shall issue a certificate of fitness to nurse practitioners who meet the qualifications, competencies, training, education and experience, pursuant to § 63-7-207(14), sufficient to prepare such persons to write and sign prescriptions and/or issue drugs

controlled_substance_schedule_authority.quote: The nurse practitioner who holds a certificate of fitness shall be authorized to prescribe and/or issue controlled substances listed in Schedules II, III, IV, and V of title 39, chapter 17, part 4, upon joint adoption of physician collaboration rules concerning controlled substances pursuant to subsection (d).

opioid_prescribing_limits.value: A nurse practitioner may only prescribe or issue a Schedule II or III opioid for a maximum of a non-refillable, thirty-day course of treatment unless specifically approved after consultation with the collaborating physician; does not apply to hospital, nursing home, or inpatient facility settings.
opioid_prescribing_limits.quote: A nurse practitioner who had been issued a certificate of fitness may only prescribe or issue a Schedule II or III opioid listed on the formulary for a maximum of a non-refillable, thirty-day course of treatment unless specifically approved after consultation with the collaborating physician before the initial issuance of the prescription or dispensing of the medication.

medication_assistant_certification_avail.quote: Any nursing home or assisted care living facility licensed pursuant to title 68 or a Program for All-Inclusive Care for the Elderly (PACE) as defined in § 56-2-121(b) may use one (1) or more medication aides to administer medications, as set forth in this section, to its patients; provided, that each and every individual used as a medication aide shall hold a current, valid medication aide certificate issued by the board of nursing under this section.

delegation_to_unlicensed_personnel_autho.quote: A medication aide shall administer medications only pursuant to delegation by a licensed nurse.

nurse_licensure_compact_member.quote: The Nurse Licensure Compact is enacted into law and entered into by this state with all states legally joining the compact

multistate_license_option_available.quote: "Multistate license" means a license to practice as a registered or a licensed practical/vocational nurse (LPN/VN) issued by a home state licensing board that authorizes the licensed nurse to practice in all party states under a multistate licensure privilege.

impaired_nurse_alternative_program_avail.quote: act as a mechanism for diversion to professional peer review organizations and/or impaired professionals associations or foundations those cases that the board, through established guidelines, deems appropriate.

telehealth_prescribing_rules.value: APRNs with a certificate of fitness may arrange for required chart review by a collaborating physician via HIPAA-compliant electronic means in certain settings (free clinics, community mental health centers, FQHCs, remote sites); up to 10 required annual remote site visits may be conducted via HIPAA-compliant electronic means.
telehealth_prescribing_rules.quote: An advanced practice registered nurse with a certificate of fitness issued pursuant to this chapter may arrange for up to ten (10) of the required annual remote site visits by a collaborating physician by HIPAA-compliant electronic means rather than at the site of the clinic.

crna_physician_supervision_model.quote: A CRNA shall collaborate in a cooperative working relationship with the ordering physician, dentist, or podiatrist in the provision of patient care, which includes consultation regarding patient treatment and cooperation in the management and delivery of health care

aprn_formulary_or_protocol_required.quote: a copy of the formulary describing the categories of legend drugs to be prescribed and/or issued by the nurse practitioner. The nurse practitioner shall be responsible for updating this information.

nursing_education_program_clinical_hours.quote: For practical nursing programs offered by a public institution of higher education, the board shall require a minimum of one thousand two hundred ninety-six (1,296) clock hours or an equivalent number of credit hours
